decision: Canonical frame: full car (Drive 1IOKNZ0p..., 25.0M tris Artec) decimated 2 mm, levelled with huracan level.py (RANSAC ground, tilt 3.7 deg, nose -Y), ive crop, 4 mm, ive prep -> car4.json; every other scan gets the same level.json + prep --like car4.json

decision: End-card logo = illumaesthetic.com cdn/shop/files/IllumaestheticLogo_V2COMPLETE_1.png (6135x1059 RGBA) -> remotion/public/illumaesthetic_logo.png

decision: All 2026 facelift part/state scans used at identity in the levelled car frame (no ICP); prepped --like car4.json
why: Red-over-silver overlays (chk/reg/reg_sheet*.jpg) sit on the car with no doubling; regcheck (150k pts/part vs 4 mm car): state scans 2.0-2.6 mm median (front_end_hood_closed 2.00, bumper_hood_removed 2.55), removed bumper parts 5.3-7.7 mm; ICP would slide parts 13-100 mm along the skin for <1 mm median gain = sliding, not a better pose

decision: Hood panel = full-car triangles in the hood zone absent (>10 mm) from both 'Bumper and Hood Removed' and 'Hood Open', largest connected component (tools/hood.py + largest.py); hinge fitted to the Hood Open scan: X axis at y=-0.979 m z=0.924 m (prepped), -60.1 deg, median 2.44 mm (tools/hinge.py, hinge.json)
why: No separate hood scan exists; Hood Open contains only the propped hood, so fitting the closed panel onto it gives the real hinge line and opening angle instead of a guessed pivot

decision: Shot plan: s1 low front 3/4 turntable (right side, -24->-44 deg) -> s2 rear 3/4 orbit (left side) -> s3 ECU right headlamp + grille mesh (2 mm) -> s4 ECU right tail lamp + IS350 badge (2 mm) -> s5 hood opens on the fitted hinge -> s6 rise to top-down -> s7 exploded front end -> logo
why: Brief/Temerario order: turntables -> extreme close-ups -> hood open -> top-down -> exploded view -> logo. No trunk-open shot: no trunk/rear state scans exist in the Lexus folder (front-end teardown only)

decision: Close-ups framed to keep both licence plates out (s3 ends before the plate, s4 starts right of it); no wheel close-up
why: Plates are crisply legible in the 2 mm scan (real registration); front wheels are largely hollow (dark rims not captured), rear spokes partial - the lamps/grille are the scan's real hero detail

decision: Exploded front end: hood (fitted panel), bumper shell (Duct and Fogs Removed), L/R fog covers, L/R ducting, radar unit+bracket, top bracket over comp_explode (car minus all of them + Bumper and Hood Removed structure, zone pad 300 mm); panels stack UP over the nose, camera nose-on 3/4 high (-22->-48 deg)
why: First preview flew parts forward along the car's length and out of the 9:16 frame (and a 40 mm fill pad left a black hole in the bay); ref 25-31 s floats panels above the car; outer layers (fog covers, shell) move first, then what they hid

decision: Licence plates (front + rear) flattened onto their fitted planes in the full car, bumper shell and Bumper-and-Hood-Removed scans before every composite (tools/deplate.py, after mazda-miata-na); car4 re-prepped --like the original car4.json (root identical)
why: Real registration legible in the 2 mm scan (depth map + preview); sibling reels converged on flattening - blank plate slab stays true to the scan shape

decision: Renders use a local copy of the ferrari-296 shot.py with Cycles persistent data off for animated-part shots (s5 hood, s7 explode)
why: huracan-evo: with persistent data the scene went unlit from the frame an animated part starts moving

decision: Radar unit/bracket kept at identity despite low regcheck overlap (7-33 %)
why: They sit behind the grille, so the full car's surface never overlaps them; ICP 'corrections' of 200-360 mm just drag them onto the grille. Overlay render places them behind the grille centre where the radar belongs

decision: s1/s2 aim points moved toward the nose/tail (s1 target y -0.75 -> -0.5, s2 y 0.95 -> 0.85, radius 5.6-6.1 m)
why: First final frame of s1 had the bumper corner on the right edge; s2 preview's tail left the frame late in the orbit - perspective pushes the near end out when aiming at the car's centre

decision: Music = lexus-is350_track.mp3 (original track generated for this reel by the coordinating session, ElevenLabs via Higgsfield; not committed). Kick grid 120.00 BPM, t0 0.064 s, 65 kicks, median residual 5 ms (tools/music_grid.py); ive beats' 60.1 BPM is a half-time octave error
why: Brief: cut on this track's accents. Kick-peak anchoring per the FG2 lesson. Structure: section A 0-15.06, 2-beat break 15.06-16.06 (kick out, -23 dB), DROP 16.063, section B to the last kick 32.063, decay to silence ~34 s (file is 40.0 s: ~6 s of silence = generated track ends early)

decision: Cuts on kicks/bar lines: s1 0-4.064, s2 -8.064, s3 -9.564, s4 -11.064, s5 hood -14.063, s6 top-down -16.063 (floats through the break), s7 explode -26.063 (panels burst ON the 16.063 drop, lock 24.063), s8 low left-side hero -30.063, logo 30.063 to the music's end (~33.6 s)
why: Holds vary 1.5-10 s (lesson: vary holds, accents not a rigid grid); close-ups are a 3-beat montage; the break is the natural breath before the money shot, so the explode separates on the drop; logo lands on the last 2-bar phrase and holds through the decay

decision: Added s8 hero (low left-side profile, bumpers cropped) between the explode and the logo
why: B section runs 16 s after the drop; a 14 s explode would drag (Temerario's is ~10 s). A new angle (s1 front-right 3/4, s2 rear-left 3/4, s8 left profile) avoids reusing a shot (FG2 lesson)

decision: SWITCHED TO FACELIFT-ONLY: the root 'Lexus 4IS IS350 Full Car.stl' is a different, older IS350 and is not used. All shots now come from the '2026 IS350 Facelift' scans (front clip)
why: Flagged by the coordinating session; verified: full car has the badge inside the spindle mesh + plate 9JTY488, facelift has the badge on a horizontal bar, different mesh, empty dealer plate frame, different wheels (chk/same/grille_wheel_cmp.jpg); grille mesh deviates p50 8-12 mm and wheels 13-32 mm from the full car while headlamps/fenders match at 0.8 mm (facelift set was aligned in Artec onto the old car's unchanged panels). Mixing them would explode facelift parts off a different car. Old-car renders s1-s5 discarded

decision: Facelift set covers only the front 1.6 m (bumper -> A-pillar base, z<=1.02 m); 'Front End Hood Closed' has no hood skin. Assembled clip = Front End Hood Closed (3 mm, islands dropped) + the facelift hood from 'Hood Open' rotated shut by the inverse fitted hinge (tools/close_hood.py)
why: No full facelift car exists in the folder; the hood panel in Hood Open is the facelift car's own hood, and the hinge (fit 2.4 mm) puts it closed - verified seated between the fenders in chk/fe/hoodfit.jpg. Turntables become front-clip orbits kept forward of the cut-off rear edge

decision: Facelift regcheck vs its own base (Front End Hood Closed): Bumper Removed 1.93, Bumper+Hood Removed 1.84, Fog Covers 2.40, Grille 2.82, Ducting 2.80, Hood Open 0.94 mm median - identity. Bumper shell (Duct and Fogs Removed) 7.29 mm -> ICP-corrected (31.9 mm, 0.64 deg) to 3.29 mm, transform pinned in shell_icp.json
why: Same-car parts agree at the noise floor; the shell alone was captured in a slightly different pose - a 4 mm median gain is a real fit, not sliding (old-car check had shown all bumper parts 5-7 mm because the grille is a different design)

decision: Facelift composites rebuilt from UNDEPLATED scans (deplate only applied to the old car's plate); no plate blanking on the facelift

decision: Facelift shot list: s1 front-right 3/4 clip orbit, s2 front-left 3/4, s3 left grille corner + fog intake (2 mm), s4 right headlamp + corner intake (2 mm), s5 hood opens to the exact Hood Open capture, s6 rise to top-down, s7 exploded teardown (hood, shell, fog L/R, duct L/R, radar, top bracket), s8 low nose-on push-in; same cut times

decision: Applied the relayed V1 rules before first delivery: Cycles persistent data OFF for every shot (shot.py), per-frame luma scan of every render folder (tools/luma.py), cut timing to be measured against the decoded audio, scene order from a scene-director agent (direction.md)
